The '''rare antiquity assessment''' was a data recording by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lucien Draay]] that contained Jedi Master [[Xamar]]'s report on the [[Muur Talisman]]. It was stolen from the [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] [[Jedi Tower]] by [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] and taken by [[Pulsipher]] to the [[Ice Citadel]] on [[Jebble]]. It was eventually recovered by [[Marn Hierogryph]] in the [[Jebble]] [[data center]].
